# run
# twice
# echo
# note the body is read from the file each time, not consumed by the first send
>>> f.rr
-- sends the same body twice --
POST {{url}}/ HTTP/1.1

{"a":1}
>>> want f.rr
-- sends the same body twice --
POST {{url}}/ HTTP/1.1

{"a":1}
HTTP/1.1 200 OK
Content-Length: 7
Content-Type: text/plain

{"a":1}
